props.heading: People talk.
props.headingRest: Here's some of what they say.

props.quote: I'd never held a chisel before. By Friday I'd built a boat that floats, and I rowed it across the harbour myself.
props.name: Priya Shah

props.quote: Our apprentices learned more in five days on the slipway than in a term of drawings.
props.name: Tom Penrose

props.quote: Our daughter came home sunburnt, smelling of varnish and talking about nothing but clinker planking. The best week of her summer, by a long way.
props.name: Mei Chen

props.quote: Small groups, proper tools and lunch on the quay. I've signed up again.
props.name: Sam Taylor

props.quote: The summer school has brought young people back to the harbour. You hear them on the slipway every July, arguing about knots.
props.name: Asha Patel

props.quote: We fund a lot of projects. This is the one people stop us in the street to talk about.
props.name: Ruth Alder

props.quote: Five days, one boat, and a group of strangers who are now my closest friends.
props.name: Jonah Reed
